summary: CoStar Group, through its subsidiary CoStar Realty Information, Inc., entered a Stock Purchase Agreement to acquire Zonda for $800M in cash at closing. The target provides new home construction data, software, and residential marketplace solutions. The transaction is not subject to stockholder or financing conditions; it requires HSR and other regulatory clearances and absence of a material adverse effect. Either party may terminate if not closed by May 28, 2027. No board recommendation or advisors are named. Watch for regulatory timeline and potential competing bids.
